name: Case File
tagline: A launch told as an investigation: typed case notes, redaction bars, red string on a corkboard and a stamp that closes the case.
description: Detective-dossier style for product launches and problem/solution stories. Grey-green paper with grain and vignette, typewriter case notes whose key facts get wiped out by black redaction bars, index-card tickets pinned to a dark corkboard and joined by red string that draws on, one huge serif number, a rubber stamp with ink texture that slams onto the file, then a clean resolved product card. Captions type out in a small dark bar at the bottom.

display.usage: The huge evidence number (≈500px) and the final wordmark (170px)

body.usage: Ticket headings, the rubber stamp (900, 110px, 12px border) and the resolved product card

mono.usage: Typed case notes 40px, card labels 15–22px tracked 0.24em, captions 32px bold in the dark bar

transitions: hard cuts between file, corkboard, evidence number, stamped file and product card
slow 2–6% push on every evidence shot
stamp impact shakes the sheet for 0.2s
textAnimations: captions type out character by character (≈0.025s per char) in a dark bar
black redaction bars wipe left→right over key facts, 0.24s each, 0.17s apart
evidence number counts 0→N with power2.out while scaling down from 1.12
stamp drops from scale 2.4 at -9° with power4.in in 0.2s

rhythm.notes: Five beats: the file, the board, the number, the stamp, the fix. One typed caption per beat; let the stamp land just after the caption starts.

guide:
- Ground is grey-green paper (#c4c7b0 → #8f937c radial) with a multiply feTurbulence grain; evidence boards are dark cork #2a2820. No pure white until the final product card (#fbfbf7).
- Case notes are Courier Prime 40px on a #e2e0cd sheet with a tracked uppercase header and rule. Redact key facts with #121310 bars that wipe scaleX 0→1 (power3.inOut, 0.24s, 0.17s stagger) after the line is readable.
- Corkboard: 4–6 index cards (#e6e3d2, slight -4° to 3° rotations, heavy drop shadow) drop in with back.out(1.6); glossy red pins pop, then #c2241f 3px strings with a slight sag draw from the hero card to each pin.
- One huge Playfair Display 900 number per piece (≈500px) counting up, circled by a hand-drawn red loop.
- Stamp: Inter 900 uppercase inside a 12px rounded border, green #2f7d4a (or red for 'unsolved'), rotated about -9°, with an feTurbulence alpha mask plus displacement for ink texture. Slam from scale 2.4 with power4.in in 0.2s and shake the sheet.
- Every beat gets one typed Courier Prime 700 caption (32px) in a #17180f bar centred at y≈950. End on a clean resolved product card plus wordmark; never show a mascot or real brand.
